source_assertions.claim: Root 0.1.0, desktop 0.11.0, Node 24.8.x, private/UNLICENSED.
CLI execute rejects above 8,000; shared input/messages limit is 20,000. No truncation is performed by that CLI guard.
Fresh desktop defaults pi-codex/adaptive/system/deepseek-v4-flash; CLI routes tutor/reviewer/lab to mock before loading settings.
New sessions start v8; saves select v9–v13 from team fields, preserve upgrade copy and reject overwriting newer versions.
20,000 messages, 12,000,000-byte complete session, 250-message content-addressed older segments; loading reconstructs complete history.
Execution journal versions 1–3, image messages select v3, 4,000,000-byte limit; database schema marker remains 6.
Default policy estimates 48,000 context / 16,384 reserved output, retains mandatory messages and whole pending/latest tool turns, rejects overflow without modifying original history.
Summary coverage validates contiguous IDs and source hash, retains newest eight messages, batches 24, pressure threshold 12,000 estimated tokens; this validates source consistency not semantic truth.
Fresh topic memory selection uses matching records else recent fallback, at most three selected memories and bounded excerpts.
Default invocation 6 turns/32 tools/10,000 events/64,000 chars/128,000 context chars/180s; 12 turns requires advertised project_ tools.

Shared catalog registers Codex, Claude, Gemini; only Codex teams enabled, Gemini execution absent. Native host accepts bounded text only, adapter probe/decode delegated, completed result remains unverified.
Ten templates are optional; three protocols plus config-derived identities; custom defaults tools true/images false/reasoning none/output 4096.
DeepSeek default 60s/deepseek-v4-flash, Kimi 150s/kimi-k3 and mainland endpoint; adapter maps thinking levels independently.
At most two members, four initial tasks, 1–6 acceptance items, DAG cycle/reference/member validation, same member not parallel, durable dispatch with new execution IDs and up to three attempts.

Defaults 12 total calls/24 tools/192,000 input/16,384 output target/240s whole team/180s member, max output 48,000. Reservations serialized and saved before calls, unknown usage retained; native token cap is observed, not provider hard bound.
Shared-output capability controls adaptive member policy; targets quick4096/balanced8192/deep16384, lead/review/planning reserved first, explicit reasoning wins.

Workspace restore creates a new workspace, remaps desktop sessions, retains original, clears access/write grants/pending queue, pauses queue, revokes MCP and selected project, merges public API definitions.
Checkpoints keep executing range and reject replay when a started tool is not replay-safe; cancellation is not rollback and local journal alone does not prove exactly-once.
Ollama identity includes digest and is rechecked, fixed loopback only, index/search bounded at5000, cosine threshold.35, top8 and rank fusion; no trained cross-encoder reranker is present.
Renderer contextIsolation and sandbox enabled, nodeIntegration disabled, permission handlers reject; IPC validation and preload constrain privileged access.
Loopback-only Node HTTP progress/SSE, transient bearer token, exact host/Origin/method checks and32 subscription limit; not cloud sync.
Distinct pre/post/delayed forms with randomized form order, user-selected mode and prompt_only/full_product; explanation review independent and no claimed causal teaching result.

814/153 and seven signed UI groups are explicitly prior engineering evidence; 18/20→20/20 is four frozen questions across arms, not20 independent questions. Two explanation issues and non-independent developer review retained.

Question bank contains60 questions with answer/analysis/tradeoff/source/followup; system design has six cases explicitly labeling capacities/cloud/fencing/outbox as assumptions or future work. Job market has7 organizations/11 roles, near-source links and access limitations, no universal demand or hiring-probability claims.
